events.evidence: Syrian government forces and Kurdish People's Protection Units capture more than a third of rebel-controlled eastern Aleppo
LaMia Flight 2933, an Avro RJ85, crashes after running out of fuel at Cerro Gordo en route to Medellín, Colombia
The Gatlinburg Fire Department orders the mandatory evacuation of downtown Gatlinburg, Tennessee, as several wildfires burn out of control in the Great Smoky Mountains National Park
